methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched via WebFetch for Guru (getguru.com/pricing, getguru.com/security), Slab (slab.com/pricing), Slite (slite.com/pricing, slite.com/security which 302-redirects to slite.slite.page), Tettra (tettra.com/pricing), Nuclino (nuclino.com/pricing), Notion (notion.com/pricing, USD via currency selector), Confluence (atlassian.com/software/confluence/pricing), and Document360 (document360.com/pricing). Where the primary page rendered only a title or geo-defaulted to EUR, two or more independent 2026 aggregators (CostBench, Automation Atlas, Featurebase, G2) were used to triangulate; a value was accepted only when consistent across the official page plus at least one corroborating source. ADVERSARIAL CORRECTIONS THIS PASS: (1) Guru is now fully quote-only on its official page, so all published per-seat figures were nulled and the model set to custom. (2) Notion Business annual is $20/seat (monthly $24), not $18/$20 as drafted. (3) Slite's HIPAA claim could not be explicitly verified on its own security page, so hipaa was set to null. No vendors were removed; all eight are real, operating products. Confluence per-user rates are the 1-50 seat band; rates decrease in higher bands. accessedAt 2026-06-18.
